hooks.command: cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command'); if echo "$cmd" | grep -qE '(npm|pnpm|yarn|bun)\s+(install|add|up|update|upgrade)(\s+\S+)*\s+\S+@latest|(npm|pnpm|yarn|bun)\s+(update|upgrade)\s+--latest'; then echo '{"decision":"block","reason":"Supply-chain policy: do not upgrade to @latest until the release is 30+ days old. Pin to a specific version you have verified is mature."}'; fi
